statement.text:
Suppose that G is a periodic group containing an elementary abelian subgroup
R of order 4. Must G be locally finite
    a) if CG (R) is finite?
    b) if the centralizer of every involution of R in G is a Chernikov group?
    Remark of 1999: P. V. Shumyatsky (Quart. J. Math. Oxford (2), 49, no. 196
(1998), 491–499) gave a positive answer to the question a) in the case where G is
residually finite.                                                       V. P. Shunkov
